scope: Bead cr-r2pa.3.1, plan 65: harness_lifecycle/playbook.md moves to the mvp-mode playbooks as skill-curation and is routed (owner ruling 2026-11-01, pstack report decision 15 (a))

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/skill-curation.md
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-01, pstack report decision 15 (a) (docs/workstreams/skill-curation/pstack-report.md §6 item 15): the curation playbook stays where it is until phase 3, then moves to .claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/ and the router lists it; owner go-ahead 2026-11-12, plan 65. harness_lifecycle/playbook.md moves here (git mv) and becomes a routed playbook for adding, placing, reviewing, comparing, updating or retiring a skill of this repository, or reviewing an upstream harness release. Steps from its one path: (1) intake bead; (2) evidence, loading only the operation's reference (placing, upstream-review, skill-review, candidate-evaluation, failure-update, moved verbatim from old §3-§7); (3) ruling recorded before any change; (4) build in an isolated worktree; (5) verify; (6) delivery, each part only with the owner's approval; (7) closeout on every exit, then a reply for done, recommendation only, awaiting a ruling, or verification incomplete. The old path was never a registered playbook, so no rename.
